### Fixed

- (muster) [Close the sign-in tab that waits too long for muster, and offer the page in the portal](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3370) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Signing in to a connector no longer leaves a blank tab: the new tab says `Opening the sign-in page…`, and after 10 seconds without the page it closes, and the connector's row offers `Open sign-in page ↗` as soon as the page is ready.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.31.0...v3.31.1
